evidence: Clicking API filter reduced list to 5 API docs; clicking All restored full 19-document list.
Document view for REST API Design Guidelines showed title, description, version v2.3.0, date 2024-01-15, Content Sections, and Related Documents.
Clicking an expanded reference link (API Versioning Strategy) and later an expanded related-document link (Error Handling) both navigated to the referenced document as the new visible document.
Collapsing 'REST Principles' hid its body paragraph and reference links became non-navigable (cursor pointer removed, clicking shows expand prompt instead of navigating), leaving section reopenable.
Re-expanding 'REST Principles' restored the body paragraph and reference links regained cursor=pointer/clickable navigation.
Chevron icon rotates 180deg (rotate-180 class) when section expanded and reverts when collapsed, matching visible body/links state.

Clicking 'Error Handling' link in collapsed 'Deprecation Policy' section kept document open and showed toast 'Please expand the section to access links'; after expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to Error Handling Standards document.

Sampled REST API Design Guidelines, API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards, and Rate Limiting documents; in each case neither content-section references nor Related Documents list included the document itself.

Clicking REST API Design Guidelines node made its circle larger (r=28, no stroke) vs others (r=20, stroke visible) as selection indicator. Zoom In changed indicator from 100% to 120%; Reset View returned it to 100%.

Graph displayed 19 node labels matching all 19 documents across 5 modules (API 5, Authentication 4, Data Layer 4, UI Components 3, Core System 3); 19 connecting lines drawn; Reset View button available to bring full graph into view.

SVG graph contains 19 outer circles (one per document) each colored per module legend (API cyan, Authentication purple, Data Layer green, UI Components orange, Core System red) and 19 line elements representing related-document connections.

issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking a document node in the Knowledge Graph (single click, repeated click, and dblclick all tested) only visually selects the node (radius/stroke change) but never navigates to or displays the document view; the app remains on the Knowledge Graph tab with no document content shown.

evidence: Nav bar exposes Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites buttons; clicking each switched the active view (verified 'active' state and distinct content for all three).

With 'Rate Limiting' selected, 'Rate Limit Tiers' collapsed and 'Rate Limit Headers' expanded, and graph zoom at 140%, switching Documents→Knowledge Graph→Favorites→Knowledge Graph preserved the selected document and exact section states throughout, and zoom remained 140% after returning to Knowledge Graph.

issue: Favorites view incorrectly inherits the Documents tab's module filter
actual: With the Documents module filter set to "API" and two favorites present (REST API Design Guidelines [API] and Accessibility Standards [UI Components]), switching to the Favorites tab displayed only "REST API Design Guidelines" — "Accessibility Standards" was missing, even though the nav badge correctly showed "Favorites 2". After resetting the Documents filter to "All" and returning to Favorites, both favorited documents appeared correctly. This confirms the Favorites view is filtered by the Documents tab's active module filter instead of always exposing every favorited document regardless of that filter.
evidence: Snapshot with Documents filter=API: Favorites list contained only e2057 (REST API Design Guidelines). Snapshot after Documents filter=All: Favorites list contained e2406 (REST API Design Guidelines) and e2420 (Accessibility Standards).

Typed "zzznonexistentquery123" into the search box: document list was replaced with a "No documents found" heading and "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria" message. Clearing the search text restored the full list of 19 documents.
